nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Configures Oxlint with React, TypeScript, and Oxc plugins, enforcing hook rules and warning on non-component exports.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the Vite React and TypeScript starter setup, its available React plugins, and options for enabling type-aware Oxlint rules.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: Defines shadcn/ui generation settings, Tailwind CSS integration, icon library, and import aliases for frontend components and utilities.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Provides the Vite HTML shell, viewport metadata, application title, and root element that loads the React entry module.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Defines the frontend's Vite, TypeScript, linting, testing, and API-type generation scripts together with runtime and development dependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: Configures strict, no-emit TypeScript compilation for the React source directory using bundler resolution and the @ path alias.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript's bundler module resolution and React's automatic JSX runtime.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Acts as the frontend TypeScript solution configuration, referencing separate application and Node-oriented compiler projects while sharing the @ alias.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TypeScript project references to split browser and tooling compilation.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Configures strict, no-emit Node-oriented TypeScript checking for the Vite configuration using NodeNext modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses NodeNext modules to type-check Vite tooling against Node APIs.
